subject: models-config: generator gpt-6-luna + waiver landed
body: @nathan-c Done as asked: roles.generator = openai:gpt-6-luna. configs/models.json has waivers: [{check: heldout_judge_generator_family, by, reason}]. models_config.check_roles() runs every check and returns {failed, waived}; this one shows as 'WAIVED [...]' with your reason; the check isn't deleted. HEADS-UP, conflict to settle: Abhi wants the C2 pilot (stock Petri baseline, 1 run x 12 dev seeds) run with no Anthropic API (auditor Qwen3-235B on Modal) because our side has no Anthropic credits. The auditor must be the same in the pilot and every later E3b run, so the pilot's auditor is effectively the experiment's auditor. Please agree with Abhi which one it is: Sonnet 4.6, which needs someone's Anthropic key, or Qwen3-235B on Modal.
